question: Mohan Veena player, Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt won the __________ Award in the year 1994.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grammy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt is an Indian classical musician who plays the Mohan Veena, a modified slide guitar.
 
• He won the Grammy Award in 1994 for his album "A Meeting by the River" in collaboration with Ry Cooder.
 
• The Grammy Awards are presented by the Recording Academy to recognize achievements in the music industry.
 
• Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt's Grammy win brought global recognition to Indian classical music and the Mohan Veena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grammy Awards**

 
 
• The Grammy Awards, or simply Grammys, are awards presented by the Recording Academy to recognize outstanding achievements in the music industry.
 
• The awards were first presented in 1959, and they are considered one of the most prestigious awards in the music industry.
 
• Categories include Best New Artist, Album of the Year, Record of the Year, and Song of the Year, among others.
 
• The Grammy Awards ceremony is held annually, and it features performances by prominent artists, as well as the presentation of those awards that have a more popular interest.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt**
 
 
• Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt is a renowned Indian classical musician known for his expertise in playing the Mohan Veena.
 
• The Mohan Veena is a modified version of the Hawaiian guitar, incorporating elements of the sitar and the veena to suit Indian classical music.
 
• Pandit Bhatt has received numerous awards and honors for his contribution to music, including the Padma Shri and the Padma Bhushan from the Government of India.
 
• His collaboration with American guitarist Ry Cooder on the album "A Meeting by the River" earned him the Grammy Award for Best World Music Album in 1994.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**
 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists in the field of performing arts, including music, dance, and drama.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• The award consists of a purse, a tamrapatra (a brass plaque), and a shawl.
 
• Many renowned artists in India, including musicians, dancers, and theater artists, have been recipients of this prestigious award.
